<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Creates a test serializer for URL-safe timed tokens.

Description: This class is a subclass of TestURLSafeSerializer and TestTimedSerializer, designed for testing purposes. It is instantiated by pytest fixtures and used to generate URL-safe timed tokens for testing scenarios.

Attributes:
    secret_key (str): The secret key used for generating and verifying tokens. Set during initialization.
</DOCSTRING>
